home.heading: Find your way through physics, mathematics, chemistry and materials science.
home.subheading: A bilingual reference and practice site, built subject by subject.

features.title: Every formula, generated fresh
features.body: Practice problems are generated from parametrised templates with a new seed each time, graded instantly in your browser — no two attempts look the same, and there's no server round-trip waiting on you.

features.title: Learn at your level
features.body: Every concept is tagged from lower secondary through bachelor core, so you can filter the roadmap to exactly the depth you need and see what each concept unlocks next.

features.title: Two languages, one glossary
features.body: English and Estonian ship side by side for every concept, with Estonian physics terminology locked against a cited glossary — not machine-translated, and never missing a locale.

footer.builtWith: Built with Next.js, Tailwind and KaTeX.
